description: Which minepoa.com routes are halted right now per POAScan's own probes (no new request to minepoa.com): Hosted mining, Assignments, Grading, Path actions, Swap writes, Tx lookup and Address lookup, each open, halted (HTTP 503 with the halt text), down (failing without it) or unknown, with since (when the run of bad reads began), as_of (newest read) and stale. Two bad reads in a row turn a route, two good reads clear it. Also swap_route, the one swap order placement status. Use it before telling a user a route works, or when notices say nothing.
name: get_route_status
title: Route status
